tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground. XAML: Background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and the sheet. One step off the ground, never a border. XAML: Surface.

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: A well inside a card, back at ground level. XAML: SurfaceSecondary.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: A 1px rule between rows inside a surface, and under the chat sheet's header. One step lighter than surface on dark, one step darker on light. XAML: Divider.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, device names, the auth code. XAML: TextPrimary.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Card subtitles and the chevron. XAML: TextSecondary.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: List headers, neutral pill text and the Back button's outline. XAML: TextTertiary.

tokens.name: text-quaternary
tokens.usage: The attach icon and the device-row dot. Same step both themes. XAML: TextQuaternary.

tokens.name: accent-advertising
tokens.usage: Advertising's fill: its badge, its Start button. XAML: AccentAdvertising.

tokens.name: accent-advertising-shadow
tokens.usage: Advertising badge shadow brush: blue-700 at 10% on light, blue-400 on dark. XAML: AccentAdvertisingShadow.

tokens.name: accent-discovery
tokens.usage: Discovery's fill, the Chat and Accept buttons, and the one filled answer in the auth-code card. Green-700 so white text clears 4.5:1. XAML: AccentDiscovery.

tokens.name: accent-discovery-shadow
tokens.usage: Discovery badge shadow brush: green-700 at 10% on light, green-400 on dark. XAML: AccentDiscoveryShadow.

tokens.name: accent-connections
tokens.usage: Connections' fill: its badge, the chip, the send button, the countdown fill. XAML: AccentConnections.

tokens.name: accent-connections-text
tokens.usage: Text-only actions in the connections hue, such as Remove and Cancel on the chat strips. Clears 4.5:1 on chat-bubble in both themes. XAML: AccentConnectionsText.

tokens.name: accent-connections-shadow
tokens.usage: Connections badge shadow brush: purple-700 at 10% on light, purple-400 on dark. XAML: AccentConnectionsShadow.

tokens.name: countdown-ring
tokens.usage: The draining ring's resting colour. XAML: CountdownRing.

tokens.name: chip-ring
tokens.usage: Stroke on a stat chip while its sheet is open. Same steps as countdown-ring. XAML: ChipRing.

tokens.name: accent-discovery-ring
tokens.usage: The Accept button's ring on the advertising page. XAML: AccentDiscoveryRing.

tokens.name: offer-window-surface
tokens.usage: The seconds-remaining well on a discovered device row. XAML: OfferWindowSurface.

tokens.name: offer-window-text
tokens.usage: The seconds in that well. XAML: OfferWindowText.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Failed sends, the outlined Disconnect and mismatch buttons, the warning ring band. Text and outline only, never a fill under white: red-700 on light and red-400 on dark clear 4.5:1 on a card, the sheet and both bubbles. XAML: StatusError.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Unverified text, the held-count badge, the Verify button, the caution ring band. Clears 4.5:1 on status-warning-surface over a card in both themes; text on its fill is white on light, slate-900 on dark. XAML: StatusWarning.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational pill ink: blue-600 on light, blue-400 on dark. XAML: StatusInfo.

tokens.name: status-success-surface
tokens.usage: Verified pill ground: green-500 at 8%. XAML: StatusSuccessSurface.

tokens.name: status-success-text
tokens.usage: Verified pill text and its check. Clears 4.5:1 on status-success-surface over a card or the sheet in both themes. XAML: StatusSuccessText.

tokens.name: status-info-surface
tokens.usage: Info pill ground: blue-600 at 16%. XAML: StatusInfoSurface.

tokens.name: status-neutral-surface
tokens.usage: Default pill ground: slate-500 at 16%. Text is text-tertiary. XAML: StatusNeutralSurface.

tokens.name: status-warning-surface
tokens.usage: Unverified pill ground: yellow-600 at 16%. XAML: StatusWarningSurface.

tokens.name: status-expired-surface
tokens.usage: Expired pill ground: red-500 at 8%. Muted; a lapsed request is expected, not an error. XAML: StatusExpiredSurface.

tokens.name: status-expired-text
tokens.usage: Expired pill and expired countdown text. Opaque, so it clears 4.5:1 on status-expired-surface over a card in both themes. XAML: StatusExpiredText.

tokens.name: chat-bubble
tokens.usage: Incoming bubble ground, and the attachment and receive strips. One step off the sheet in each theme, so the shape still reads on light. XAML: ChatBubble.

tokens.name: chat-bubble-outgoing
tokens.usage: Outgoing bubble ground, in the hue of the send button: a pale tint on light, and on dark a deep one, dim enough that a photo stays the brightest thing in it. XAML: ChatBubbleOutgoing.

tokens.name: chat-bubble-text
tokens.usage: Message text, and the outlined Retry on a failed send. XAML: ChatBubbleText.

tokens.name: chat-bubble-media-text
tokens.usage: The failure remedy line inside a bubble. XAML: ChatBubbleMediaText.

tokens.name: chat-bubble-timestamp
tokens.usage: Timestamp, right-aligned. Clears 4.5:1 on both bubbles in both themes. XAML: ChatBubbleTimestamp.

tokens.name: card-shadow
tokens.usage: Card shadow brush: slate-900 at 30% on light, black on dark; MAUI draws it at 60% opacity. XAML: CardShadow.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, device names. XAML: CardTitle.

styles.name: card-subtitle
styles.usage: The line under a title. XAML: CardSubtitle.

styles.name: list-header
styles.usage: Section header above a device list, in text-tertiary. XAML: ListHeader.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Pills, the countdown caption, the auth-code instruction and buttons. XAML: FontSizeSM.

styles.name: chip-count
styles.usage: The number in the connected-devices chip.

styles.name: timestamp
styles.usage: Chat timestamps and the video details line. XAML: ChatTimestampLabel.

styles.name: auth-code
styles.usage: The six-digit code, centred. XAML: ChatAuthenticationCode.

styles.name: icon-inline
styles.usage: Chevron and check marks beside text.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its subtitle; list item spacing. XAML: SpacingXS.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Bubble padding; sheet header spacing; above and below a card's chip row. XAML: SpacingSM.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Column gap in cards; stack spacing in the auth-code card. XAML: SpacingLG.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card padding; page row spacing; sheet margin. XAML: SpacingXL.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills and the Retry button.

tokens.name: radius-send
tokens.usage: The 44px send square and the device-row well.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Full-width buttons and the Back button.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: The 56px feature badge and chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and the bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: The connected-devices chip: a full pill.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card that can be used; a disabled card drops it. A card in a list needs 10px above and 22px below it for the shadow. MAUI: Offset 0,6 Radius 16 Opacity 0.6 over card-shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-badge-advertising
tokens.usage: Under the advertising badge. Light is near-invisible by design; dark glows.

tokens.name: shadow-badge-discovery
tokens.usage: Under the discovery badge.

tokens.name: shadow-badge-connections
tokens.usage: Under the connections badge.
